items.name: system-menu-layout
items.title: System Menu Layout
items.description: Pause-menu style screen: Tabs as primary sections, MenuList on the left, detail Panel on the right (Split stacks them in a narrow container). Controlled value maps a tab to a route; works without a router.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Router-agnostic: pass value + onValueChange (e.g. derived from useLocation / navigate) to make each tab a route. Panel transitions follow --motion-panel.
